# Location scope: a building the food rule builds has a level under construction here (the rule waits for it).
pp_cplan_food_queued = {
	any_buildings_in_location = {
		building_levels_under_construction > 0
		OR = {
			building_type = building_type:wheat_farm
			building_type = building_type:wheat_farmstead
			building_type = building_type:wheat_rotations
			building_type = building_type:wheat_model_farm
			building_type = building_type:rice_farm
			building_type = building_type:rice_farmstead
			building_type = building_type:rice_rotations
			building_type = building_type:rice_model_farm
			building_type = building_type:millet_farm
			building_type = building_type:millet_farmstead
			building_type = building_type:millet_rotations
			building_type = building_type:millet_model_farm
			building_type = building_type:maize_farm
			building_type = building_type:maize_farmstead
			building_type = building_type:maize_rotations
			building_type = building_type:maize_model_farm
			building_type = building_type:legume_farm
			building_type = building_type:legume_farmstead
			building_type = building_type:legume_rotations
			building_type = building_type:legume_model_farm
			building_type = building_type:potato_farm
			building_type = building_type:potato_farmstead
			building_type = building_type:potato_rotations
			building_type = building_type:potato_model_farm
			building_type = building_type:olive_farm
			building_type = building_type:olive_farmstead
			building_type = building_type:olive_rotations
			building_type = building_type:olive_model_farm
			building_type = building_type:cattle_farm
			building_type = building_type:cattle_farmstead
			building_type = building_type:cattle_rotations
			building_type = building_type:cattle_model_farm
			building_type = building_type:camel_herders
			building_type = building_type:camel_stud
			building_type = building_type:eng_royal_forest
			building_type = building_type:fishing_village
			building_type = building_type:net_curing_yard
			building_type = building_type:forest_village
			building_type = building_type:managed_forest_village
			building_type = building_type:fruit_orchard
			building_type = building_type:nursery_orchard
			building_type = building_type:pomological_orchard

			building_type = building_type:hurdled_sheepcotes
			building_type = building_type:tavern
		}
	}
}
